mapper.sql: id, employee_id, organization_unit_id, position_id, assignment_type, status, active_primary_marker, effective_from, effective_to, reason, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_primary_marker = 1 AND effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC

SELECT assignment.id, assignment.employee_id, assignment.organization_unit_id, assignment.position_id, assignment.assignment_type, assignment.status, assignment.active_primary_marker, assignment.effective_from, assignment.effective_to, assignment.reason, assignment.version, assignment.create_time, assignment.create_by, assignment.edit_time, assignment.edit_by FROM t_employee_assignment assignment INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization_unit ON organization_unit.id = assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization_unit.migration_placeholder = 0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id = assignment.position_id AND position.code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE assignment.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY CASE assignment.assignment_type WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 0 WHEN 'SECONDARY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, assignment.effective_from DESC, assignment.id DESC
SELECT FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status IN ('PLANNED', 'ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM t_employee_assignment WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND status IN ('PLANNED','ACTIVE') AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_employee_assignment (employee_id, organization_unit_id, position_id, assignment_type, status, active_primary_marker, effective_from, effective_to, reason, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{organizationUnitId}, #{positionId}, #{assignmentType}, #{status}, #{activePrimaryMarker}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{reason}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
